one_liner: AI meeting assistant with recordings, transcripts, summaries, and API/MCP access to meeting data.
access_notes: Self-serve on all plans, including Free: API keys, webhooks, SDKs, and OAuth app registration are available without gating. Public OAuth apps may be subject to review, but credentials can still be created self-serve. See https://www.fathom.ai/features/api and https://developers.fathom.ai/.
blocker_notes: Hard rate limit of 60 requests per minute across all API keys per user, with no higher limits available at this time (per help.fathom.video article).

evidence.quote: “API keys, webhooks, and SDKs are included on every Fathom plan, including Free.”
